Per line: speed (× the speaker's), pre/post (ms of silence before/after the voice), say (what is spoken, if not `text`), estVoice (s: the predicted voice length, tools/estimate.py; replaced by the real voice once tools/voice.py has run).

source: THE FULL-EPIC TRAILER, third cut (pipeline number 97; never a numbered episode). Told once, in order, no image and no phrase twice. Every beat was read in the constituted text of the BORI Critical Edition (GRETIL e-text, lab/ce/): the verses, a Sanskrit quotation for each and everything cut or reworded are in script/TRAILER-CHECK.md; the edit is planned shot by shot in script/TRAILER-EDIT.md. In short: 1.94.86-90, 1.104.10-15 and 3.292.6-7, 1.107.1, 1.132.8-12 and 1.136.4-10, 1.139.1-4 and 1.142.28-31, 1.155.41, 2.42.21-25, 2.53-54 and 2.58.29-37, 2.61.40-41 (the cloth: no cause is named; Krishna is not shown), 2.67.9-10 and 2.68.1 (deerskins), 5.125.26, 6.23.21-47 (the chariot between the armies; the bow let go), 6.33.3-35 (the universal form; 'I am Time' is 6.33.32 kalo 'smi), 6.114.81-85, 7.33.12 and 7.48.13, 8.66.60-65 and 8.67.24, 11.25.36-42, 17.1.23-31 and 17.3.7-8, 1.1.52 (itihasa). 'Iti-ha-asa: so indeed it was' is the traditional analysis of the word, not a verse.
structure: TITLE (music from the first frame, the name, no voice) -> THE STORY ONCE, IN ORDER, in the present tense: the vow, the river, the cousins, the fire, the demon, the altar, the wheel, the dice, the cloth, exile, the needle-point -> STOP 1 -> the conch: two armies, the only time they are named; Arjuna lowers his bow; the universal form, the one long hold -> the war in order, the fastest cutting -> the curse -> the dog -> STOP 2 -> the word itihasa -> the promise -> who makes this and what to do -> the end card, held.

names.Karna: born in armour, a charioteer's foster-son

loop.hookQuestion: What does the archer see when he will not fight?

strings.supportLine: Support the series: follow, share, comment
strings.sourceLine: Text: the Mahabharata · BORI Critical Edition

lines.note: OPENING, no voice; SOUND ON THE FIRST FRAME (a drum and the conch at level, no fade-in): from high above, two armies as dark masses under a red dawn, banners moving, the camera coming down; MAHABHARATA arrives large, legible by 1.5 s.

lines.text: Long ago, a prince swears away his throne and his line.
lines.note: CE 1.94.86-90: a slow push-in on the young prince's face as he raises his hand before the fisher-king; flowers begin to fall. Plaque: Bhishma.

lines.text: A mother gives her first-born to the river.
lines.note: CE 1.104.10-15, 3.292.6-7: the basket with the shining child, close; the camera pulls back and the river takes it. Plaque: Karna.

lines.text: A hundred brothers. Five cousins. One throne.
lines.note: CE 1.107.1: Duryodhana large in the foreground; the focus racks to the five across the hall, then to the one seat. Plaque: Duryodhana.

lines.text: A palace built to burn.
lines.note: CE 1.132.8-12, 1.136.4-10: the lacquered house in flames; a tilt down through the earth to six figures leaving by a tunnel with one lamp.

lines.text: Bhima breaks a man-eating demon.
lines.note: CE 1.139.1-4, 1.142.28-31: the rakshasa reaches; Bhima's blow lands and the shot is CUT three frames after the contact.

lines.text: A woman rises from a fire-altar.
lines.note: CE 1.155.41: Draupadi rises out of the middle of the altar; the camera rises with her. Plaque: Draupadi.

lines.text: Krishna lets the wheel fly.
lines.note: CE 2.42.21-25: Krishna in colour, seen from behind the shoulder, his face turned away and in shadow; the wheel leaves his hand and the camera goes with it. Plaque: Krishna.

lines.text: Then the dice.
lines.note: CE 2.53-54: the dice rattle before the picture; a push-in on Yudhishthira's face as he decides. Plaque: Yudhishthira.

lines.text: A king stakes his kingdom, his brothers, his wife.
lines.note: ONE SENTENCE, ONE CLIP, TWO PICTURES (CE 2.58.29-37). From above: the dice fall and strike the red cloth; on the frame before 'his brothers' the picture cuts to the stakes swept across the cloth to Shakuni's side: five crowns, then a red veil.

lines.text: They pull at her cloth.
lines.note: CE 2.61.40: close: a hand hauls the red cloth across the frame; her figure holds still.

lines.text: The cloth does not end.
lines.note: CE 2.61.41: the pull-back: the hall of seated kings around her, heads bowed, and the cloth running out of frame and heaped on the floor. No cause is shown; Krishna is not there.

lines.text: Thirteen years of exile.
lines.note: CE 2.67.9-10, 2.68.1: six figures walk away under great trees, deerskins over their shoulders (ajinany uttariyani).

lines.text: Duryodhana will not give a needle-point of earth.
lines.note: ONE SENTENCE, ONE CLIP, TWO PICTURES (CE 5.125.26): the court, the envoy (Krishna, in colour, his back to us) in the foreground, the focus going to the king on his seat; on the frame before 'a needle-point' THE CLOSE-UP: a push-in on Duryodhana's face. STOP 1: on the frame after 'earth' every sound cuts to nothing; the push, the lamp and the embers go on.

lines.text: Two armies stand ready for war.
lines.note: THE TURN (CE 6.23.20-21), out of the first stop: the conch before the cut; both armies, one chariot standing between them. The only time the armies are named.

lines.text: Arjuna lowers his bow.
lines.note: CE 6.23.47: a slow push-in on Arjuna as he sits and the bow leaves his hand; Krishna beside him turned away from us. Plaque: Arjuna.

lines.text: He asks to see. Krishna shows him everything. “I am Time.”
lines.note: THE SIGNATURE SHOT AND THE ONE LONG HOLD (CE 6.33.3-35; every drawn element is cited in TRAILER-CHECK.md): tight on Arjuna's face; the light of a thousand suns comes up on it; the camera pulls back and up until he is a speck with joined palms under a form with many faces, eyes and arms that leaves the frame on every side; below it the two armies lit by it, and streams of warriors going up into its mouths. Where it happens in the text: between the lowered bow and the war.

lines.text: Bhishma falls on a bed of arrows.
lines.note: CE 6.114.81-85: the arrows are heard before the picture; from his face back to the whole bed of arrows: he does not touch the ground; the field at sunset.

lines.text: A boy, alone against many.
lines.note: CE 7.33.12, 7.48.13 (eko bahubhih): Abhimanyu, sword up; the ring of spears and wheels closes from both sides. The blow is not shown.

lines.text: Karna's wheel, sunk in the earth.
lines.note: CE 8.66.60-64, 8.67.24: Karna on his knees, heaving at the wheel; the red sun behind him; the wheel drops into the earth; CUT three frames after it stops.

lines.text: A mother of a hundred sons curses Krishna.
lines.note: CE 11.25.36-42: Gandhari, blindfolded, her hand rising toward Krishna, who stands with his back to us; a field of fires behind.

lines.text: And at the end, a king will not abandon his dog.
lines.note: CE 17.1.23-31, 17.3.7: snow and the mountain; the old king walking up, the dog at his heel; he stops and turns to it. The quietest shot. STOP 2: after 'dog' every sound cuts dead, the clock with it; the snow goes on falling.

lines.text: It calls itself itihasa. Iti. Ha. Asa. So indeed it was.
lines.note: After the full stop (CE 1.1.52): dark, embers; the word in gold, large, a slow push-in; its three parts land on the three spoken syllables, each with its gloss; then the meaning. One struck note under 'was'.

lines.text: Every book. Every vow. Every war.
lines.note: THE PROMISE, one clip: the names of the eighteen books run up the frame in gold; a drum on each 'Every'.

lines.text: From the first verse to the last.
lines.note: The Naimisha fire at the blue hour; the storyteller comes to it.

lines.text: Nothing added for effect.
lines.note: First light: Vyasa by the great fire, a hand opening to us.

lines.text: We are making this, episode by episode.
lines.note: Palm leaves laid down one after another, each with its lines of writing, a cord through them: the series as it is made.

lines.text: If you want it told this way, follow and support the series.
lines.note: The listeners' ring at the fire seen from behind, and one empty place in it, lit: yours.

lines.text: Episode one is waiting.
lines.note: THE END CARD, held at least 4.5 s and always moving (fire, embers, a slow push-in): FOLLOW largest, with a pulsing ring and a pointer; then 'Watch Episode 1 · The Storyteller Arrives'; then 'Support the series: follow, share, comment' small; then the source line. Nothing in the bottom 420 px or the right-hand 160 px. One struck note on the cut; it rings under the card over the fire.
